scenes.situation: You arrive at the airport and ask a staff member where to go for your flight to Mumbai.

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the departure terminal?
What is your destination?
I am traveling to Mumbai.
Please go to Terminal 2.
Thank you.
Have a pleasant journey.

scenes.situation: You check in for your flight and hand over one suitcase.

lines.en: Hello, I would like to check in.

lines.hi: कृपया अपना पासपोर्ट और टिकट दीजिए।
lines.roman: Kripyaa apnaa passport aur ticket deejiye.
lines.en: May I have your passport and ticket, please?
Here they are.

lines.hi: क्या आपके पास कोई चेक-इन सामान है?
lines.roman: Kyaa aapke paas koee check-in saamaan hai?
lines.en: Do you have any checked baggage?
Yes, I have one suitcase.
Your boarding pass is ready.

scenes.situation: You ask the check-in staff for a window seat.

lines.hi: क्या मुझे खिड़की वाली सीट मिल सकती है?
lines.roman: Kyaa mujhe khidkee vaalee seat mil saktee hai?
lines.en: Could I have a window seat, please?
Let me check.
Thank you.
Yes, one is available.
Thank you very much.

scenes.situation: Your baggage is over the weight limit and you ask how much to pay.

lines.hi: आपका सामान निर्धारित सीमा से अधिक है।
lines.roman: Aapkaa saamaan nirdhaarit seemaa se adhik hai.
lines.en: Your baggage exceeds the allowed weight limit.
How much extra weight do I have?
You have four kilograms of excess baggage.
How much do I need to pay?

lines.hi: कृपया भुगतान काउंटर पर शुल्क जमा कर दीजिए।
lines.roman: Kripyaa bhugtaan counter par shulk jamaa kar deejiye.
lines.en: Please pay the excess baggage fee at the payment counter.

scenes.situation: A security officer tells you what to put in the trays.

lines.hi: कृपया अपना लैपटॉप और मोबाइल अलग ट्रे में रखिए।
lines.roman: Kripyaa apnaa laptop aur mobile alag tray mein rakhiye.
lines.en: Please place your laptop and mobile phone in a separate tray.
Certainly.

lines.hi: अपनी जेब की सभी धातु की वस्तुएँ भी निकाल दीजिए।
lines.roman: Apnee jeb kee sabhee dhaatu kee vastuen bhee nikaal deejiye.
lines.en: Please remove all metal items from your pockets.
Okay.

lines.hi: धन्यवाद, अब आप आगे जा सकते हैं।
lines.roman: Dhanyavaad, ab aap aage jaa sakte hain.
lines.en: Thank you. You may proceed now.

f.hi: धन्यवाद, अब आप आगे जा सकती हैं।
f.roman: Dhanyavaad, ab aap aage jaa saktee hain.

scenes.situation: You have lost your boarding pass and ask for a new one.

lines.hi: मेरा बोर्डिंग पास खो गया है।
lines.roman: Meraa boarding pass kho gayaa hai.
lines.en: I have lost my boarding pass.
Please show me your passport.
Here it is.

lines.hi: मैं नया बोर्डिंग पास जारी कर देता हूँ।
lines.roman: Main nayaa boarding pass jaaree kar detaa hoon.
lines.en: I will issue a new boarding pass for you.

scenes.situation: You ask when your flight will leave and learn it is delayed.

lines.en: When will my flight depart?

lines.hi: उड़ान लगभग एक घंटे विलंब से चलेगी।
lines.roman: Udaan lagbhag ek ghante vilamb se chalegee.
lines.en: Your flight has been delayed by about one hour.
Will there be any further updates?
Yes, an announcement will be made.

scenes.situation: You ask which gate your flight leaves from and how to get there.

lines.hi: मेरी उड़ान का गेट कौन-सा है?
lines.roman: Meree udaan kaa gate kaun-saa hai?
lines.en: Which gate is my flight departing from?
Your flight will depart from Gate 18.
How do I get there?

lines.hi: सीधे जाइए और दाईं ओर मुड़ जाइए।
lines.roman: Seedhe jaaiye aur daaeen or mud jaaiye.
lines.en: Go straight ahead and then turn right.

scenes.situation: You need a wheelchair to reach the boarding gate.

lines.en: I need a wheelchair, please.

lines.hi: अवश्य। मैं तुरंत व्यवस्था करता हूँ।
lines.roman: Avashya. Main turant vyavasthaa kartaa hoon.
lines.en: Certainly. I will arrange one for you immediately.
Thank you.

lines.hi: हमारा कर्मचारी आपको बोर्डिंग गेट तक ले जाएगा।
lines.roman: Hamaaraa karmchaaree aapko boarding gate tak le jaaegaa.
lines.en: One of our staff members will assist you to the boarding gate.

scenes.situation: You feel dizzy at the airport and tell a staff member.

lines.hi: मेरी तबीयत ठीक नहीं लग रही है।
lines.roman: Meree tabeeyat theek naheen lag rahee hai.
lines.en: I am not feeling well.
What seems to be the problem?
I feel dizzy.

lines.hi: कृपया बैठिए। मैं चिकित्सा दल को बुलाता हूँ।
lines.roman: Kripyaa baithiye. Main chikitsaa dal ko bulaataa hoon.
lines.en: Please have a seat. I will call the medical team.

scenes.situation: You hear the final boarding announcement and check with a staff member.

lines.hi: यात्रियों से अनुरोध है कि वे तुरंत बोर्डिंग गेट संख्या 12 पर पहुँचें।
lines.roman: Yaatriyon se anurodh hai ki ve turant boarding gate sankhyaa baarah par pahunchen.
lines.en: Passengers are requested to proceed immediately to Boarding Gate 12.

lines.hi: क्या बोर्डिंग शुरू हो गई है?
lines.roman: Kyaa boarding shuroo ho gaee hai?
lines.en: Has boarding started?
Yes, it has. Please proceed quickly.
Thank you.
